verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking-as-a-service platform (not itself an agent), so an official MCP server for connecting agents is a fair axis to expect, but the evidence pack contains no mention of MCP, agent connectivity, or any such server—only standard API/docs content and failed probes for API specs. Missing for 10: any documentation of an MCP server, agent integration tooling, or even an OpenAPI spec that could underpin one.
